subject: reasoning
question: Anil starts from Point Y and drives 12 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn and drives 36 km, then turns left and drives 33 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 17 km. He takes a left turn and drives 21 km. He then turns right and drives 19 km, then turns right and drives 13 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Anil starts from Point Y and drives 12 km towards the south.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 36 km, then turns left and drives 33 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 17 km.
 
• He takes a left turn and drives 21 km.
 
• He then turns right and drives 19 km, then turns right and drives 13 km to stop at Point Z
